subject: Performance clarity & short-term improvement plan
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance clarity & short-term improvement plan

Mina,

I wanted to follow up from our 1:1 last week — I left the meeting concerned about a recent pattern: missed delivery dates on two sprint commitments, lack of proactive updates on blockers, and a couple of code reviews that required significant rework.

This is an attempt to be explicit and give you a very short-term, focused space to stabilize before we consider formal HR steps. My ask:

- Acknowledge receipt of this note today.
- Join a 30-minute alignment meeting tomorrow so we can surface specifics and agree on a 30-day improvement checklist.
- Prepare the two recent PRs (PR #482, PR #491) for a paired review — bring the list of known blockers.

I'll share clear checkpoints and evidence-based expectations in the follow-up. This is an informal coaching step intended to support you. If you want someone from People in the meeting, cc me back and I will include Laura.

Thanks,

--
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Performance clarity & short-term improvement plan

Karthik,

Got it — thanks for the clear note. I want to address this and would appreciate concrete examples so I can correct course. I can meet tomorrow at 11:00 or 15:30; either works for me. I'll pull together the PR diffs and a short list of blockers.

Appreciate the opportunity to fix this.

—Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance clarity & short-term improvement plan

Mina — thanks for confirming and for prepping. Per our meeting this morning, I'm summarizing the specifics we reviewed and the short-term expectations so we have a shared record. Laura is cc'd so People can support and advise.

Summary of concerns (examples):
- Delivery: Feature branch for multi-tenant cache (PR #482) missed the sprint target by 6 days. Root cause: underestimated integration testing time and delayed asking for help.
- Communication: Multiple times the team learned of blocker status only during retro; not enough daily updates to the squad channel or to me directly.
- Quality: PR #491 required two major refactors after review comments; the changes suggested basic design mismatches (thread-safety around KV cache).

Short-term improvement plan (30-day checkpoints):
1) Week 1 (alignment): Paired review of PR #482 and PR #491 with me (we did the first session today). Deliverable: updated PRs with addressed comments, list of unresolved items and their owners.
2) Week 2 (visibility): Daily standup brief plus end-of-day note in #inference-team on blockers; escalate unresolved blockers to me by 4pm PT.
3) Week 3 (quality): Two paired reviews with a senior engineer on design approach before larger refactors; final sign-off before merging critical changes.
4) Week 4 (stabilize): Measure: zero missed sprint commitments for the current sprint; code review turnaround time average under 48 hours for your assigned reviews.

Success criteria: demonstrable improvement across these checkpoints. If, after this informal coaching window, there is not consistent improvement, we will consider formal HR steps including a PIP conversation.

Attachments: one-on-one-notes-20270725.txt (my notes from prior meetings)

Next steps:
- Laura: please advise on People support and documentation we should include in this thread (I deferred to you in the meeting).
- Mina: confirm you accept the plan and we'll calendar the checkpoints.

Thanks,

--
Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Kent <alan.kent@peoplematters.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Performance clarity & short-term improvement plan — confirmation and resources

Forwarding the agreed notes and adding a short, practical checklist we use to document informal coaching steps. Mina — thank you for engaging here; below is the confirmation of what we discussed and a lightweight support plan. This is an informal record and not a formal PIP.

Agreed items (you confirmed in our call on 2027-08-04):
- You accept the 30-day checkpoints and will follow the weekly cadence above.
- Karthik will run the paired reviews and record outcomes in the shared drive.
- You will post a short end-of-day blocker update to #inference-team and escalate blockers by 4pm PT.

People support and resources: 
- I attached a two-page development checklist (development-checklist.pdf) that maps activities to evidence we will track.
- If you'd like coaching on time estimation and design reviews, Alan Kent from People Matters (external consultant) is available next week — Alan is cc'd.

Follow-ups & documentation:
- Please upload meeting notes and PR link updates to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-hr-devplans
- We'll have a formal 30-day check-in on 2027-08-31. If milestones are met, this file will be closed. If not, we'll discuss next steps including HR formalization.

Action for Mina: reply to this thread to confirm you accept the plan and that you are comfortable with the documentation path.

Thanks and we’re here to help get you back on track.

Best,

Laura Bennett
People Partner, Employee Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: development-checklist.pdf

Laura / Karthik — thank you for the clear summary and the checklist. I confirm I accept the 30-day plan and will follow the steps outlined. I will:

- Upload paired-review notes and the updated PR links to the Drive folder by EOD Friday.
- Book two paired-review sessions with the senior engineer you recommended.

If anything changes or if I need additional support I'll flag it early.

—Mina
